data.body: Fixed: Added --force flag to ticket-transition.sh that skips the open-children guard when closing. When --force is used, the parent ticket closes and open children remain open with a warning listing them. The error message for the non-force case now also mentions --force as an option. Updated ticket-cli-reference.md with the new flag, behavior description, and example. Added Test 25 to test-ticket-transition.sh verifying the flag behavior.
